restriction_review.scope: Nineteen independently qualified Basic/Formed Suspension bodies, explicitly named tiers VIII-IX. All19 primary output IDs and two newly needed Sludge ingredient IDs directly observed and matched; all selected literal formulas, quantities and numeric trivials independently observed. Formed Suspension of Frost IX is excluded: primary16858 explicitly binds96331, but current finite exact-ID foundation read confirms item96331 absent. No replacement item ID or invented item fields.
restriction_review.historical: SOE developer Ngreth dated2006-03-13 potion exchange list explicitly maps each selected Basic/Formed name and tier VIII/IX from old potion names. Positive dated identity/family evidence supports coordinator-accepted labelled PoR11 reconstruction only. Per-item maintained primary literal formulas and numeric trivials are independent manufacturing authority. No immutable2006 or May2013 exact-field claim, no X+ inference.
restriction_review.actor: Every source explicitly requires Shaman. Existing normal and auto Alchemy code checks Shaman and minimum level25. Skill59; omitted minimum skill0, ordinary must_learn0/book0/quest0/enabled1/nofail0 policies. Static actor mapping reused from RRC221, no core edits or native acceptance.
restriction_review.quantity: Each source yields one stackable uncharged item. Literal six ingredient kinds/seven physical units, including one herb twice, and individual numeric trivials are preserved. Current native maxcharges0 and stackability/capacity checked; no charge or stack-cap normalization, co-products or failure returns invented.
restriction_review.containers: Bind only exact portable Medicine Bag17901, independently authenticated primary1141, eight slots and LARGE capacity. All ingredient sizes and seven physical units fit current native bag fields. Other named bags and modern Alchemy Tables remain separately unqualified.
restriction_review.preservation: 39 exact18-field dependencies: 27 fresh and 12 reused. Zero current full-input/name/output peers. Exact fields/new IDs/full logical entry multisets/counts/learned refs guarded; no existing item or recipe edits.
restriction_review.execution: Source prepared for normal publication and exact one-use SQL GO. Named count contracts; no new rehearsal, tests, build, restart or native gameplay campaign. Overall recipe coverage remains incomplete.
